# Renderer trial

Every fixture in the corpus (`packages/report-corpus/src/fixtures`), rendered
by each candidate engine through its trial adapter (`src/trial/`), read back
with PDF.js and judged by the corpus's own checks, as
[0003](decisions/0003-a-rendered-report-is-proved-on-the-pdf-it-produced.md)
requires. The checks are the ones each engine's suite runs, on the PDF that
engine produced.

**Generated by `packages/report-corpus/src/trial/run.ts`, dated 2026-10-15;
do not edit it by hand.** Every outcome, page count, time and version below
was measured or read by the run that wrote it; the numbers in a fixture's
title are the fixture's own. Regenerate it from the repository root:

```bash
pnpm --filter @formancy/report-corpus build
node packages/report-corpus/dist/trial/run.mjs --date YYYY-MM-DD
```

## Machine

- **Operating system:** Windows 11 Pro (Windows_NT 10.0.26200, x64)
- **CPU:** Intel(R) Core(TM) i9-10900K CPU @ 3.70GHz, 20 logical CPUs
- **Memory:** 31.9 GiB
- **Node.js:** v24.21.0

## Engines

Each version is read from the package's installed `package.json` by the run.

| Adapter | Package | Version | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| pdfmake | `pdfmake` | 0.3.11 | lays out the document |
| pdfmake | `pdfkit` | 0.19.1 | writes the PDF; pdfmake's own dependency |
| pdfme | `@pdfme/generator` | 6.2.4 | lays out the template and writes the PDF |
| pdfme | `@pdfme/schemas` | 6.2.4 | the text, table, image and line boxes |
| pdfme | `@pdfme/common` | 6.2.4 | the template model and pagination |
| pdfme | `@pdfme/pdf-lib` | 6.2.4 | the PDF writer |
| every check | `pdfjs-dist` | 6.4.299 | reads every PDF back |

## The corpus

Each fixture is one way a report goes wrong. **pass** is a PDF in which the
checks find nothing wrong, with its pages; **refused as expected** is the
refusal the fixture allows, naming what it must; **FAIL** gives the first
problem the checks found, and the next section all of them.

| Fixture | Expected | pdfmake 0.3.11 | pdfme 6.2.4 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `empty-dataset`: An empty dataset: the header, the empty text and a zero total on one page | a PDF | pass, 1 page | pass, 1 page |
| `one-row`: One row: a title, one row, its total and the footer on one page | a PDF | pass, 1 page | pass, 1 page |
| `long-table`: A long table: 300 rows, the header on every page, Page n of N | a PDF | pass, 7 pages | pass, 7 pages |
| `tall-row`: A row taller than a page: continued whole, or refused as too large | a PDF, or refusal `content-too-large` | pass, 10 pages | refused as expected: `content-too-large` naming `lines` |
| `long-paragraph`: A long paragraph and an unbroken identifier: all of it, inside the margins | a PDF | pass, 5 pages | pass, 5 pages |
| `group-boundary`: Groups that end at page boundaries: no orphaned group header, exact subtotals | a PDF | pass, 4 pages | **FAIL** (4 pages): page 2: the last table row is the group header 'Region R19' |
| `summary-fits`: A summary that just fits, or just does not, swept across the page boundary: whole on one page, moved only once it does not fit | a PDF | pass, 15 pages | pass, 18 pages |
| `summary-overflows`: A summary that does not fit and moves whole to a new page | a PDF | pass, 3 pages | pass, 3 pages |
| `decimals`: Exact values: large decimals, integers past 2^53, signed zeros and Swiss grouping, verbatim | a PDF | pass, 1 page | pass, 1 page |
| `null-missing`: Null and missing values: empty cells and placeholders, every row still present | a PDF | pass, 1 page | pass, 1 page |
| `fonts`: Fonts: German, French, Swiss, euro and Polish text, embedded and extracted verbatim | a PDF | pass, 1 page | pass, 1 page |
| `images`: A valid PNG, drawn at its size inside the margins | a PDF | pass, 1 page | pass, 1 page |
| `image-invalid`: An image whose bytes are not an image: refused, naming the asset | refusal `invalid-asset` naming `logo-broken` | refused as expected: `invalid-asset` naming `logo-broken` | refused as expected: `invalid-asset` naming `logo-broken` |
| `oversized`: An oversized job: 6000 rows against a 20-page limit, refused, never truncated | refusal `too-many-pages` | refused as expected: `too-many-pages` | refused as expected: `too-many-pages` |

## What failed, in full

### `group-boundary` with pdfme

- page 2: the last table row is the group header 'Region R19'

## Render times

How they were measured: each document was rendered by each adapter once and
judged as above. That render warms the engine and is not timed. The document
was then rendered as many times again as the Runs column says, one after
another in the same Node.js process, each timed alone with `performance.now()`
around the adapter's `render` call, so reading and judging the PDF are not in
it. A refusal is timed until the adapter refuses. The median is the time; the
fastest and slowest runs show the spread.

- `long-table`: A long table: 300 rows, the header on every page, Page n of N
- `group-boundary`: Groups that end at page boundaries: no orphaned group header, exact subtotals
- `hundred-pages`: The long-table fixture at 4790 rows and their total, about a hundred pages
- `oversized`: An oversized job: 6000 rows against a 20-page limit, refused, never truncated

| Document | Engine | Outcome | Runs | Median | Fastest | Slowest |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `long-table` | pdfmake | pass, 7 pages | 5 | 178 ms | 176 ms | 180 ms |
| `long-table` | pdfme | pass, 7 pages | 5 | 286 ms | 274 ms | 288 ms |
| `group-boundary` | pdfmake | pass, 4 pages | 5 | 135 ms | 133 ms | 137 ms |
| `group-boundary` | pdfme | **FAIL** (4 pages): page 2: the last table row is the group header 'Region R19' | 5 | 181 ms | 179 ms | 184 ms |
| `hundred-pages` | pdfmake | pass, 100 pages | 5 | 1829 ms | 1805 ms | 1862 ms |
| `hundred-pages` | pdfme | pass, 100 pages | 5 | 5257 ms | 5151 ms | 5381 ms |
| `oversized` | pdfmake | refused as expected: `too-many-pages` | 5 | 802 ms | 797 ms | 821 ms |
| `oversized` | pdfme | refused as expected: `too-many-pages` | 5 | 1633 ms | 1621 ms | 1643 ms |

## Reading

- **pdfmake**, on 14 fixtures, rendered 12 that pass, refused 2 as their fixtures expect, and failed none.
- **pdfme**, on 14 fixtures, rendered 10 that pass, refused 3 as their fixtures expect, and failed 1: `group-boundary`.
- `tall-row` allows a PDF or a refusal. pdfmake: pass, 10 pages; pdfme: refused as expected: `content-too-large` naming `lines`.
- `long-table`, fastest first by median: pdfmake 178 ms, then pdfme 286 ms.
- `group-boundary`, fastest first by median: pdfmake 135 ms, then pdfme 181 ms. pdfme's time is for a PDF that fails its checks.
- `hundred-pages`, fastest first by median: pdfmake 1829 ms, then pdfme 5257 ms.
- `oversized`, fastest first by median: pdfmake 802 ms, then pdfme 1633 ms.

What this does not show. A pass means the checks found no problem in the text
and images PDF.js reads back; they cannot see rules, borders, clipping or
colour (0003). A time is the adapter's, not the bare engine's: whatever an
adapter measures or checks before the engine writes the PDF is inside it. The
times come from one process on one machine that nothing reserved for the run,
not from the documented four-vCPU worker plan section 20 sets its targets
for, so those targets are not judged here. Neither memory nor cancellation is
measured.
